headline: Doubao to pull agent features ahead of China's companion rules
body: A quiet day. ByteDance's Doubao, with 345 million monthly users, said it will remove agent features when China's rules on human-like AI services take effect, a slight pullback in AI Autonomy and a nudge to Surveillance. Other lines drifted as earlier stories faded. Horizon Balance: +1.12.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); Protector God shifted most, by three hundredths, as the Doubao story slightly eased AI Autonomy.
coming_up: China's interim measures on anthropomorphic AI services take effect July 15; Doubao removes agent features that day
